name: Jasper Finley
source: You've been warned about Jasper. You know that for some reason, he's pursuing you; that he wants you dead. Why does he resent you so much? Why hasn't he killed you yet? The answers must be out there, but getting them will require a great risk. Will you stay away? Or will your curiosity get the best of you?
